text: A DAO will not be a genuinely profitable addition to the economy until decentralized versions of the legal system, the political system, the media, banking, and other services exist to support it.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205

isBasedOn.name: Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization

abstract: The legal system, the political system, the media, banking, and other services are all needed before the first DAO will be a genuinely profitable addition to our economy.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: profit-seeking DAOs competing in the contemporary economy
